conclusions.rationale: Pre-insertion recovery for unavailable/uncertain destinations, post-insertion recovery for method failures including the 007 failure outcomes, no Enter, display with overlay style none and replacement of the 006 reason display are all observable; SC-001/SC-003 make them measurable.

conclusions.rationale: Three-way classification, foreign-process focus as undetermined, and the gating rule (only not editable with setting on recovers) are testable with a classification seam.

source_citations.excerpt: Only "not editable" with the setting "Show the bubble when no text field is focused" on (default on) shows the bubble with reason "No text field is focused".

conclusions.rationale: Content (two-line preview, exact reason sentences, handle, Copy, Close, explanation), non-activation, first click and accessible names are checkable. See the non-critical ambiguity about the reason for a running pinned app that cannot be activated.

source_citations.excerpt: It does not take keyboard focus from other applications, accepts the first click, and has accessible names for every control.

conclusions.rationale: Native copy-mode drag with full payload and preview, hide during drag, reappear on refusal, close on acceptance with 'drop accepted' only, and identity guarding are testable; SC-002 bounds native expectations.

source_citations.excerpt: If a drop is accepted, the bubble closes and the outcome is logged as "drop accepted" without the transcript, never as text verified in a field.

conclusions.rationale: Copy semantics including the 007 changeCount interaction, Close, conditional history statement, new-dictation closing, no timeout and no history deletion are explicit.

source_citations.excerpt: The bubble has no automatic timeout. Closing the bubble never deletes the history entry.

conclusions.rationale: Reduced Windows and Linux bubbles with explicit causes and actions.
